definitions.gloss: to hand over, to deliver in person, to hand to
definitions.explanation: To give something directly to someone by hand, rather than sending it by mail or through an intermediary. Emphasizes the physical, face-to-face delivery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{手渡|てわた}した。
examples.english: I handed over the letter directly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賞状|しょうじょう}→賞状：30671_shoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{手渡|てわた}した。
examples.english: The company president handed out the certificates one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{郵送|ゆうそう}→郵送：03176_yuusou⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{手渡|てわた}し→手渡し：15628_tewatashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Since these are important documents, please deliver them by hand rather than by mail.
examples.notes: {手渡|てわた}し is the noun form meaning 'hand delivery.'

notes:
{手渡|てわた}す emphasizes direct, face-to-face delivery. It is used when the personal nature of the handoff is important.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手渡|てわた}す: A hands ~ to B

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{手渡|てわた}す: to hand over directly
- ⟦{手渡|てわた}し→手渡し：15628_tewatashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver by hand
- ⟦{手渡|てわた}し→手渡し：15628_tewatashi⟧: hand delivery (noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over, to pass (more general)
- ⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver
